'''Ellor Koota''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who lived during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Koota lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Oluna Biqua]] on [[Genarius]], where he was a vagrant. Along with the rest of the city's population, he was infected by the gas [[Trinex-M]] when it was released there. It drove him insane, making him have visions and giving him violent mood swings. He began wearing his [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] inside out and wore a plastic box on his head, which he hoped would block out the visions.
